newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says GAN still to be privatised.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says GAN still to be privatised.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday that the government still planned to privatise insurer GAN despite its decision to call off for now the sale of GAN banking unit CIC.
"There is no question of the state remaining GAN's shareholder in the long term," he said.
But he told reporters that he did not think GAN could be sold at the same time as CIC, which is still to be privatised in the future.
"The total made up of GAN and CIC does not seem possible to assimilate," he said.
If GAN were privatised ahead of CIC however, the state would then have to assume full control of the banking unit. "That is not a procedure that has my favour," he said.
He also said that GAN would not be recapitalised this year.
